description: An oil painting of a roofless Gothic stone ruin with tall tracery windows and spires on the left, joined to an angular pink-red sandstone modern building with a tall glass wall etched with figures on the right. A charred two-beam wooden cross stands in rubble in the foreground under a dark stormy sky. Small lettering reading FATHER FORGIVE is painted on the low wall at lower left. No frame or border; nothing graphic.
reason: Legible painted lettering (FATHER FORGIVE) on the low wall at lower left of the ruins. Repaint that wall without any text.
